text: 金十数据7月27日讯，商务部新闻发言人表示，创新不是任何一方的专利。中国人工智能企业长期深耕基础研究，坚持科技自立自强与开放合作并重，秉持共商、共建、共享理念，推动人工智能技术快速发展，在前端代码能力等越来越多的领域取得喜人成就。据了解，很多美国人工智能企业在研发和训练中蒸馏了中国的模型。值得注意的是，美业界众多企业公开反对美国威胁制裁中国人工智能企业。近200家美国初创企业敦促美国政府不要切断对中国开源模型的访问，认为这将削弱美国企业竞争力。一些美国大型跨国企业表示，模型蒸馏是一种行业广泛应用的技术，应允许美国企业使用中国开源人工智能模型。
text_en: Jin10 data July 27 - Ministry of Commerce spokesperson said innovation is not a patent of any party. Chinese AI companies have long been deeply engaged in basic research, adhering to both technological self-reliance and openness, upholding the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, promoting rapid AI development, and achieving gratifying results in more and more fields such as front-end code capabilities. It is understood that many U.S. AI companies have distilled Chinese models during R&D and training. Notably, many U.S. industry companies publicly oppose U.S. threats to sanction Chinese AI companies. Nearly 200 U.S. startups urged the U.S. government not to cut off access to Chinese open-source models, arguing that would weaken U.S. corporate competitiveness. Some large U.S. multinationals stated that model distillation is a widely used industry technology, and U.S. companies should be allowed to use Chinese open-source AI models.
